title: aglaia exstipulata
intro: Aglaia exstipulata, commonly known as the Philippine copperleaf, is a plant species native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aglaia exstipulata include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential as a natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and coumarins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal activities.
